facts.fact: A Le Defi Media blog by Vishal Askurn states that Mauritius does not currently have a single, comprehensive AI Act, and that existing laws such as the Data Protection Act 2017 and sector guidance supply safeguards.

systems.system: Financial Services Commission Fintech Series Guidance Notes No. 4

note: Not a statement that Mauritius has no AI rule at all (it names sector guidance), so no standing fact; FAIR Guidelines are described as non-binding; the blog is named-analyst opinion.
